name: monochrome-unicorn
author: Tyler Whittaker
description: Monochrome Unicorn: a web app for Zebra thermal printers, served from the printer's onboard web server (E:INDEX.SHTML)

scripts.prepare: if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then git config core.hooksPath tools/githooks; fi
scripts.test: for f in test/*.test.mjs; do node "$f" || exit 1; done
